name: Tartaros Academy
card_quote: "I'm competitive but not at the highest level. I want to challenge myself and learn the game."
card_desc: → Academy was made just for people like you. You'll be reaching for top 100 (and sometimes cracking top 25), surrounded by skilled players to help you learn and get better at the game.
modal_quote: "I'm competitive but not at the highest level. I want to challenge myself and learn the game."
modal_desc: Academy is built for players who are genuinely competitive but not quite at main team level yet — and that's completely fine. You'll be surrounded by skilled players who want to help you improve, pushing for top 100 placements and occasionally punching higher. Think of it as the competitive development squad. Many of our main team players came through Academy first.
requirements: Regular ticket usage — expected to participate actively each event
Willingness to learn — open to feedback and new strategies from experienced players
Decent scoring — contributing meaningfully to team placement each event
Discord active — checking in on plans and staying across coordination
Drive to improve — the goal is to keep getting better and eventually push to main
